focus.title: 美国拟对中国芯片制造设备出口实施额外许可要求，涉及成熟制程及维修服务
focus.summary: 据多家媒体报道，美国商务部工业安全局（BIS）预计将于近期发布一项临时最终规则，将对中国半导体制造设备的出口管制扩大至部分成熟制程（28nm及以上）设备，并要求对在华晶圆厂的设备维修服务申请额外许可。该规则可能影响已在华布局的美资、日资及荷兰设备商。建议涉及半导体设备采购、维护的中国企业立即审查供应链合同中的不可抗力与合规条款，并评估替代备件来源。
focus.title_en: U.S. to Impose Additional Export License Requirements on Chipmaking Equipment to China, Covering Mature Nodes and Repair Services
focus.summary_en: Multiple media reports indicate that the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) is expected to soon issue an interim final rule expanding export controls on semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China to include certain mature nodes (28nm and above) and requiring additional licenses for equipment repair services at Chinese fabs. The rule may affect U.S., Japanese, and Dutch equipment suppliers with operations in China. Chinese companies involved in semiconductor equipment procurement and maintenance are advised to immediately review force majeure and compliance clauses in supply contracts and evaluate alternative spare parts sources.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：中国企业与东南亚合作方因疫情不可抗力条款争议获支持
case.summary: SIAC（新加坡国际仲裁中心）近期就一起中国企业与东南亚合作方的合同纠纷作出裁决，确认因疫情导致的供应链中断构成合同约定的不可抗力事件，中方企业无需承担延迟交货的违约责任。该案明确了不可抗力条款中“政府措施”与“客观障碍”的举证标准，对出海企业起草合同中的不可抗力条款具有重要参考价值。仲裁庭强调，当事人应及时通知并提供充分证据。
case.title_en: SIAC Award: Chinese Company's Force Majeure Defense Upheld in Dispute with Southeast Asian Partner Over COVID-19 Delays
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) recently ruled in a contract dispute between a Chinese company and its Southeast Asian partner, confirming that supply chain disruptions caused by the pandemic constituted a force majeure event under the contract, relieving the Chinese company from liability for delayed delivery. The case clarifies the evidentiary standards for 'government measures' and 'objective impediments' under force majeure clauses, offering valuable guidance for Chinese enterprises drafting such clauses in cross-border contracts. The tribunal emphasized timely notice and sufficient evidence.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区商事调解规则互认试点正式启动，跨境纠纷解决效率有望提升
policy.summary: 广东省司法厅与香港、澳门法律部门联合宣布，自2026年7月15日起在大湾区内地九市及港澳地区试行商事调解规则互认。试点允许经内地认可的调解机构与港澳调解机构相互认可调解协议，并可直接申请法院执行，无需重复公证或转递。此举旨在降低跨境商事纠纷解决成本，尤其利好中小型出海企业。建议企业将调解条款纳入跨境合同，并选择互认名录内的调解机构。
policy.source: 来源：广东省司法厅公告 · 2026.07.22
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Launches Pilot for Mutual Recognition of Commercial Mediation Rules, Boosting Cross-Border Dispute Resolution Efficiency
policy.summary_en: The Department of Justice of Guangdong Province, together with legal authorities in Hong Kong and Macao, announced that from July 15, 2026, a pilot program for mutual recognition of commercial mediation rules will be implemented in the nine mainland cities of the Greater Bay Area and the two SARs. The pilot allows mediation agreements reached by recognized mediation institutions in the mainland and the SARs to be mutually recognized and directly enforceable by courts without the need for repeated notarization or transmission. This initiative aims to reduce the cost of resolving cross-border commercial disputes, particularly benefiting small and medium-sized enterprises. Companies are advised to include mediation clauses in cross-border contracts and choose mediation institutions from the mutual recognition list.
policy.source_en: Source: Announcement of the Department of Justice of Guangdong Province · 2026.07.22

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期合规准备要点
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起正式征收碳关税。建议对欧出口钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢产品的中国企业在过渡期内完成三项准备：1. 建立产品级碳排放数据核算体系，按欧盟方法学报告直接与间接排放；2. 核查供应链上游供应商的碳排放数据，防范数据不一致风险；3. 评估碳价抵扣机制，了解中国碳市场与EU ETS的对接可能性。未及时合规的企业将在正式实施后面临额外成本及市场准入障碍。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Key Compliance Preparations for EU CBAM Transition Period
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The EU CBAM transitional period ends in late 2026, with full carbon tariff implementation starting in 2027. Chinese exporters of steel, aluminum, cement, fertilizers, electricity, and hydrogen to the EU are advised to complete three preparations during the transition: (1) establish product-level carbon emission accounting systems, reporting direct and indirect emissions per EU methodology; (2) verify upstream suppliers' carbon data to avoid inconsistencies; and (3) assess carbon price offset mechanisms and the potential linkage between China's carbon market and the EU ETS. Companies failing to comply in time will face additional costs and market access barriers upon full implementation.
